items.rationale: Stock cover is on hand divided by weekly sales: 240 / 30 = 8 weeks.
95 / 40 = 2.375, and rounding to 1 decimal place gives 2.4.
A style with zero weekly sales cannot be divided into stock, so the plain formula returns #DIV/0!. IFERROR replaces that error with a message. ROUND does the rounding, not IFERROR.
Cover is stock divided by weekly sales. Doubling the sales (the bottom number) halves the answer, so the same stock lasts half as long.
